title: Correct turns ratio
description: Essential: The final answer must state the turns ratio as n₁:n₂ = 2:1 or n₂:n₁ = 1:2.

title: Bulb current identification
description: Important: Recognizes that each bulb operates normally with the same current I, since they are identical and glowing normally.

title: Secondary current calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the total secondary current as 2I from the parallel connection of L₃ and L₄.

title: Primary current determination
description: Important: Correctly identifies the primary current as I from the series connection of L₁ and L₂.

title: Transformer current relationship
description: Important: Applies the ideal transformer relationship I₁/I₂ = n₂/n₁ to connect currents to turns ratio.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Shows clear algebraic steps to solve n₁/n₂ = I₂/I₁ = (2I)/(I) = 2.

title: Inverted ratio mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly states the ratio as 1:2 by confusing the primary/secondary relationship or inverting the current ratio.

title: Parallel/series current error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error in calculating total secondary current (e.g., treating parallel bulbs as series) or primary current (e.g., treating series bulbs as parallel).
